A conventional brush, clean cloth stack and a reusable opaque unlabelled bottle. His gaze is down and to the side at an item he is presenting with a small gesture to an unseen colleague, definitely not facing the camera. Beautiful natural crosslight and subtle film grain. Capture him three-quarter, medium wide from the storeroom doorway at 40mm, body on the centre-right with soft shadow to left, genuine working environment. Avoid posed portraits or clinical-looking laboratories.

Logo reference: use the attached exact company geometric K and KetuviClean lettering, in plain white thread, following polo perspective; never replace it by a generic K or an invented mark, no colored patch. Only employees wear uniforms. Any microfibre in view is Ketuvi turquoise #17C3B2. The reference supplies only logo geometry; create an entirely original photographic scene.

Create one original natural on-location photographic reportage image, 3840×2160 horizontal 16:9 single exposure. Aim for a premium but honest editorial feature about everyday cleaning in Quebec. Believable hands, facial skin texture, pores, fabric folds, retained window highlights, real contact shadows and subtle lens imperfections. Documentary, quietly luminous, no CGI, no image composites, no overlaid words, no dramatic color wash, no studio backdrop, no text graphic on the picture, no decorative sparkles, no watermark. Realistic anatomy and simple well-formed hand interactions.
